reader.requirement: At --std 85 an executed SUPPRESS inhibits, for that instance of its group, (a) the print lines, (b) all LINE clause processing (no page-fit test, no page advance, including LINE integer ON NEXT PAGE), (c) the NEXT GROUP clause (including NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE) and (d) any change to LINE-COUNTER, for every group type; sum processing (crossfoot, roll-forward, reset) is not among the inhibited functions (§1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR10 d/f).
reader.edition-search: Same greps as GR2: BeginGroup returns false on a suppressed group before any page-fit, line placement or ApplyNextGroup, with no edition read; the engine Edition DialectBehaviors (SumSizeErrorBlanksPrintableItem, GroupIndicateConsumedByIssuedGenerate, TerminateDiscardsSavedNextGroup, ControlFootingPageGroupsSeePriorControlValues) are not on the suppressed-group branch.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no (2023 adds item e, control-break sensing unaffected, which the 1985 GR10/GR11 order gives too)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1c31 covers a suppressed DE (LC, NEXT GROUP PLUS, fit-test advance) and l1m8 a suppressed group's counters; RH NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE, CH LINE n ON NEXT PAGE and CF NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE suppressed are not exercised

reader.notes: BeginGroup runs the sum additions, the declarative, then returns false for a suppressed group after only the end-of-group sum reset, matching the 1985 GR10 a-f order (reset step f still runs). Every presentation path (body, PH, PF, RH/RF) funnels through BeginGroup.

refuter.evidence: Read ReportWriter.cs#BeginGroup (returns false for a suppressed group after the end-of-group sum reset, before any page fit, line or ApplyNextGroup), #PresentBody (the saved absolute NEXT GROUP location is consulted only after BeginGroup returns true), #PlaceAfterSavedNextGroup. Probe s3_save_suppress.cob (--std 85): DE-A NEXT GROUP 5 at LC 6 fills the save location (LC=18); a suppressed DE-B then leaves LC=18 PC=01 and the save location intact (no LINE processing, no page advance, no LINE-COUNTER change); the next unsuppressed DE-B advances and prints at line 6 of page 2 (LC=06 PC=02), i.e. the suppressed group did not consume the saved NEXT GROUP.
